set.body:
CODE RED D1A SOURCE-TO-STORY SEAM. Begins after C1. D0 may proceed in parallel. This slice migrates only acquisition, compiler and story source support; it does not touch align or codecs.

Exact paths:
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/proposal.scala
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/resolve.scala
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/task.scala
- acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/ProposalSuite.scala
- acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/ResolveSuite.scala
- acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/TaskSuite.scala
- document/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/document/compiler.scala
- document/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/document/CompilerSuite.scala
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/model.scala
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/nodes.scala
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/alignment.scala
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/evidence.scala
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/validate.scala
- story/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/story/ValidatorSuite.scala
- story/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/probes/StoryModelUnforgeableSuite.scala

Required result: acquisition proposals and SourceSupport carry typed EvidenceSupport; NarrativeCompilerInput consumes checked NarrativeSourceAtlas while preserving exact SurfaceAtlas text construction; all four current concrete atlas annotations migrate without stage-order change; StoryModel holds checked bundle plus atlas and retains explicit safe text access for text models; story nodes and AlignmentSource retain heterogeneous support and its primary projection without fabricating SpanSet or canonical text.

Courts: every current text fixture and span lookup is unchanged; film source has no callable text slicing without an admitted text stream; foreign bundle, axis, stream or anchor refuses; empty or mixed unsupported evidence refuses; compiler accepts partial proposals and preserves gaps; no default epistemic status or source projection; changing support cannot retain a foreign claim, model or build receipt; apply, copy, fromProduct and Mirror doors remain closed for joined records. A source with no canonical text compiles through the same deterministic stages and retains movie intervals.

Gate: exact reference-scope output; acquire, document and story JVM, JS and Native tests plus compileAll and scalafmtCheckAll; text golden parity; film contract fixture; external construction probes; independent type and scientific review. No aligner, codec, output, provider or decoder edit.
set.title: D1A migrate acquisition, compiler and StoryModel to heterogeneous source support
